cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Get It on the Record
cards.instruction: Get formal approval, endorsement, or acknowledgment before anyone can quietly revise their position.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Initial the festival budget total before lunch, please. I'll file the approved copy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I said yes. Just write my name on it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can enter your name, but you supply the approval. Put your initials beside the total yourself.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I may change my mind. I'd want that copy removed.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then date any replacement. We keep the first copy too; please don't confuse revising a decision with erasing it.
